description: Changes one table's name within its dataset. Nothing is rebuilt, re-served or republished, and the table keeps its id, versions and schedule; every reader of the dataset sees the new name. The old name is released, so another table may take it, and a later recipe revision must name the table by its new name. A name is lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, at most 63 characters, and unique within the dataset. Example: {"table_id": "…", "name": "daily_observations"}. Returns {table_id, dataset_id, name, previous_name, changed, dashboard_url}. A name another table of the dataset holds is refused name_taken; an archived table cannot be renamed. Only call it when the person you are working for has asked for the new name.
name: rename_table
title: Rename a table
